dogecoin.text: Sure, meme coins onboarded millions—Dogecoin was a gateway. But at what cost? A distracted ecosystem where speculation drowns substance. They’re not crypto’s strength—they’re its leech.

Meme coins suck up attention and capital. In 2021, Dogecoin’s market cap hit $90B—more than many real companies—yet it’s a Paypal clone with a dog logo. That’s billions that could’ve fueled DeFi or blockchain infrastructure. Instead, it’s speculative noise.
